test_modes.name: Link training / loopback
test_modes.purpose: NVHS lane training, de-skew, and PHY loopback for SerDes characterization at the target line rate.

test_modes.name: Eye / margin probe
test_modes.purpose: Per-lane eye-margin measurement (especially for PAM4 at Gen4) to validate signal integrity.

test_modes.name: CRC error injection / replay test
test_modes.purpose: Inject a flit CRC error to verify the replay path recovers transparently.

test_modes.name: Lane deconfigure test
test_modes.purpose: Force a lane down to verify graceful link-width narrowing.

spec_provided_observability.name: Per-link CRC + replay counters
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Each flit is CRC-protected; CRC-error and replay counts per link are observable via the driver/NVML for signal-integrity health.

spec_provided_observability.name: Link state + width probe
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Current link state (Down/Training/Active/Sleep) and active lane-pair width (full brick = 8 pairs/direction, reduced on lane deconfigure) are observable per link.

spec_provided_observability.name: Bandwidth / throughput counters
spec_provided_observability.purpose: TX/RX byte counters per link expose achieved NVLink bandwidth (nvidia-smi nvlink / NVML).

spec_provided_observability.name: NVSwitch fabric health
spec_provided_observability.purpose: The NVSwitch fabric manager exposes per-port link state, routing, and error telemetry for all-to-all fabrics.

spec_provided_observability.name: Lane margining / eye health
spec_provided_observability.purpose: NVHS PHY exposes per-lane eye/margin diagnostics (implementation-defined), important for PAM4 (Gen4) where the three eyes are smaller.

error_detection_mechanisms: Per-flit CRC — detects a corrupted 16-byte flit; triggers replay.
Replay-count threshold — repeated CRC failures flag a degraded lane/link.
Lane lock / de-skew failure during training — link fails to reach Active.
Lane deconfigure event — a permanently failing lane is dropped, narrowing the link.
PAM4 symbol error (Gen4) — eye closure detected; corrected by replay / FEC where present.
Coherence/transaction protocol error (NVLink-C2C) — malformed coherent request.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: A flit fails CRC and is replayed; counter increments.
A failing lane is dropped; link width narrows.
NVSwitch fabric manager detects a port/link state change.

notes: NVLink observability is implementation-defined and surfaced through the NVIDIA driver / NVML / nvidia-smi nvlink and the NVSwitch fabric manager rather than a public spec. Per-flit CRC + replay counters are the primary in-band signal-integrity diagnostic; PAM4 at Gen4 increases the importance of per-lane eye/margin telemetry. JTAG / scan / BIST are integrator-side at the GPU/NVSwitch SoC.
